title: Sparkly crescent moon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='moonGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff9c4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd54f'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='sparkGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a5d6ff'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- outer glow of moon -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='50' r='38' fill='#ffe082' opacity='0.15'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='50' r='34' fill='#ffe082' opacity='0.2'/>
  <!-- crescent moon body: big circle -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='50' r='32' fill='url(#moonGlow)'/>
  <!-- dark cutout circle to make crescent, in deep navy/blue -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='46' r='26' fill='#1a1a40'/>
  <!-- subtle crescent highlight edge -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='50' r='32' fill='none' stroke='#fffde7' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- moon's cute face: eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='44' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#3e2723'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='44' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- sleepy/happy eye -->
  <path d='M 32 55 Q 36 49 40 55' fill='none' stroke='#3e2723' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='56' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ffab91' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M 36 60 Q 40 64 44 60' fill='none' stroke='#3e2723' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkle 1: top left -->
  <g transform='translate(20,22)'>
    <path d='M0,-8 L2,-2 L8,0 L2,2 L0,8 L-2,2 L-8,0 L-2,-2 Z' fill='url(#sparkGlow)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 2: top right -->
  <g transform='translate(76,18)'>
    <path d='M0,-6 L1.5,-1.5 L6,0 L1.5,1.5 L0,6 L-1.5,1.5 L-6,0 L-1.5,-1.5 Z' fill='url(#sparkGlow)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 3: right -->
  <g transform='translate(84,50)'>
    <path d='M0,-5 L1,-1 L5,0 L1,1 L0,5 L-1,1 L-5,0 L-1,-1 Z' fill='url(#sparkGlow)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 4: bottom right small -->
  <g transform='translate(68,80)'>
    <path d='M0,-4 L1,-1 L4,0 L1,1 L0,4 L-1,1 L-4,0 L-1,-1 Z' fill='url(#sparkGlow)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 5: bottom left -->
  <g transform='translate(22,78)'>
    <path d='M0,-5 L1.5,-1.5 L5,0 L1.5,1.5 L0,5 L-1.5,1.5 L-5,0 L-1.5,-1.5 Z' fill='url(#sparkGlow)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tiny dots / distant stars -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#e1f5fe' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#e1f5fe' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#e1f5fe' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='12' r='1' fill='#e1f5fe' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='88' r='1.3' fill='#e1f5fe' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='62' r='1' fill='#e1f5fe' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
